trace.notes: Mapped the downloaded Springer chapter PDF. The source contains 4 main sections of problems plus references, with explicit Problem labels on PDF pages 2-14.
Extracted one-dimensional small-divisor problems from sections 1.1-1.3.
Extracted finite-dimensional and Z^k-action problems from section 2.
Extracted KAM, twist-map, Euler-Lagrange, and n-body problems from section 3.
Extracted skew-product, spectral, and Hamiltonian PDE problems from section 4.

Moved Problem 1.2.1 to needs_review because the source points to an external lecture for the definition of condition H, so the question could not be made fully self-contained from the chosen artifact alone.
No near-duplicate questions were merged. Each accepted item corresponds to a distinct explicit problem label in the source.
